'''Kendra Novar''' was a female [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]. As a talented [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]], Kendra originally used her skills to rob casinos, but after a brief period in prison, she joined the military. It was stated that she had a good heart.
